title: The Hidden Sayyad and His Accomplice Are Punished

blocks.text: Once the Khalsa breaks into the place, fighting continues through houses, lanes, and secret refuges. The Singhs search room by room and descend even to the underground cellar where the abductor has attempted to hide from the reckoning he thought would never reach him.

The Brahmin's daughter identifies the culprit, and the Singhs drag him from concealment to face exemplary punishment. The same investigation exposes the local wine-seller who had served as facilitator and procurer in the search for girls.

Justice on the page is therefore both personal and public. The tyrant and his accomplice are destroyed, the daughter is recovered, and the Khalsa leaves behind a warning that predatory power will not remain safe merely because it sits close to Delhi.
